component.name: Lumeo
component.summary: Find, acquire and watch films and series

description.p: Lumeo is a media library, acquisition and playback platform: one Go binary with SQLite behind a Flutter desktop client. It browses a catalogue that needs no API key, ranks the ways to watch a title by the health of the swarm before its resolution, and starts playing while the file is still arriving — with what the swarm is doing shown in the player bar.
Subtitles are matched to the copy being played rather than to the title, and arrive as UTF-8 whatever code page they were written in.

ul.li: Keep running when closed: downloads go on, and the tray or a notification brings the window back (Settings → General).
Работа в фоне после закрытия окна: загрузки идут, окно возвращается из трея или уведомления (Настройки → Общие).
Start at login, in the background.
Запуск при входе в систему, в фоне.
Ctrl+Q quits.
Ctrl+Q закрывает приложение.
Linux: a right click on the top bar opens the window menu, which can keep the window on top.
Linux: правый клик по верхней панели открывает меню окна, где его можно закрепить поверх остальных.
The subtitle menu is shorter: only downloaded tracks are marked, and a format shows only when it tells two tracks apart.
Меню субтитров короче: помечены только скачанные дорожки, а формат виден, только когда отличает две дорожки.

Episodes of a season downloaded whole show as downloaded as soon as they finish; before, a piece that failed its check left an episode looking missing until it was opened. Episodes caught by it show as downloaded again after the update.

Серии сезона, скачанного целиком, отмечаются скачанными сразу после загрузки; раньше из-за куска, не прошедшего проверку, серия выглядела недоступной, пока её не откроешь. Затронутые серии снова станут скачанными после обновления.
Picking another copy of an episode that is already on disk no longer pauses the new one while it looks for peers, and the title page offers the copy picked last.
Выбор другой копии уже скачанной серии больше не ставит новую на паузу, пока она ищет пиров, а страница сериала предлагает копию, выбранную последней.
The subtitle track that is on is checked in the menu again.
Включённые субтитры снова отмечены галочкой в меню.
Subtitles kept with a download are chosen over the file's own when their language is higher in Settings, and a language picked for the series holds.
Скачанные субтитры выбираются вместо встроенных, если их язык стоит выше в настройках, и язык, выбранный для сериала, больше не сбрасывается.
Subtitle rows say where each track comes from: in the file, downloaded or OpenSubtitles; two of one language show their format or SDH.
У субтитров подписано, откуда дорожка: в файле, скачаны или OpenSubtitles; у двух дорожек одного языка виден формат или SDH.
An episode counts as watched once the ending its file names starts, and a watched episode opened by mistake stays out of Continue watching.
Серия считается просмотренной с начала эндинга, если он размечен в файле, а случайно открытая просмотренная серия не попадает в «Продолжить просмотр».
New episodes no longer lists an episode before the last one watched.
В «Новых сериях» больше нет серий раньше последней просмотренной.
A series caught up with opens on its next episode, with the day it airs.
Сериал, в котором всё вышедшее просмотрено, открывается на следующей серии с датой выхода.
The subtitle delay set for an episode is there again when you come back to it.
Задержка субтитров, выставленная для серии, сохраняется, когда вы к ней возвращаетесь.
Posters show a ring only while something is downloading, and Continue watching marks the episode it plays.
На постерах кольцо показывается только во время загрузки, а в «Продолжить просмотр» значок относится к серии, которую запустит карточка.
A waiting download keeps its percent in sight and says No network when there is none.
У ожидающей загрузки виден процент, а без сети она пишет «Нет сети».
The source list is asked again after 15 minutes at most, so copies of an episode out today show up.
Список источников обновляется не реже раза в 15 минут, так что копии вышедшей сегодня серии появляются.
A subtitle file that stops downloading fails after 5 seconds of silence instead of 20, and the player says so; picking it again retries.
Файл субтитров, который перестал скачиваться, отбрасывается после 5 секунд тишины, а не 20, и плеер сообщает об этом; повторный выбор пробует снова.
The subtitle list asks every database at once and answers within 15 seconds, with whatever the ones that answered had.
Список субтитров опрашивает все базы одновременно и приходит не позже чем через 15 секунд — с тем, что успели дать ответившие.
Choosing an episode no longer flashes "Looking for sources…" under Play when the list is quick.
При выборе серии под кнопкой «Смотреть» больше не мелькает «Ищу источники…», если список пришёл быстро.
Subtitles are kept with each download: the best match in each of your subtitle languages is saved beside the file and plays offline. The subtitle menu marks them "on disk".
Субтитры сохраняются вместе с загрузкой: лучшие для каждого вашего языка субтитров лежат рядом с файлом и работают без сети. В меню субтитров они помечены «на диске».
Freeing one episode of a season pack no longer makes the next one wait for the network before it plays.
Удаление одной серии из пака сезона больше не заставляет следующую ждать сети, прежде чем она запустится.
Closing the window during playback no longer crashes the app.
Закрытие окна во время просмотра больше не роняет приложение.
A subtitle database that does not answer no longer holds up the next episode.
База субтитров, которая не отвечает, больше не задерживает следующую серию.
A download resumed without a network knows its files at once, and switching episodes asks the sources once instead of every time.
Загрузка, продолженная без сети, сразу знает свои файлы, а при переключении серий источники опрашиваются один раз, а не каждый раз.
An episode finished just before a restart is kept for the usual time instead of being freed at once.
Серия, досмотренная перед перезапуском, хранится обычный срок, а не удаляется сразу.
Without a network the home page opens at once, with what you were watching. It used to wait up to 15 seconds for the catalogue, and twice that after an update.
Без сети главная открывается сразу, вместе с тем, что вы смотрели. Раньше она до 15 секунд ждала каталог, а после обновления вдвое дольше.
An episode or film on disk plays at once, from its page and as the next episode, without waiting for the sources to answer.
Скачанный фильм или серия запускаются сразу, со страницы и как следующая серия, не дожидаясь ответа источников.
When the sources do not answer, the player and the season download say so instead of "no copy", and the next episode's download tries again by itself.
Когда источники не отвечают, плеер и скачивание сезона так и говорят, а не «нет копии», а загрузка следующей серии пробует снова сама.
A subtitle the database was too slow to send is reported as failed instead of loading as an empty file.
Субтитры, которые база не успела отдать, считаются ошибкой, а не загружаются пустым файлом.
The player opens on black instead of flashing the title's artwork, and the spinner appears only if the film takes more than a second to start.
Плеер открывается на чёрном экране, без мелькающего постера, а колесо загрузки появляется, только если фильм запускается дольше секунды.
The home page no longer hitches when you start scrolling. The top bar darkening used to redraw the whole page under it.
Главная больше не дёргается в начале прокрутки. Раньше, когда темнела верхняя панель, заново строилась вся страница под ней.
The banner's picture covers the whole width again. In 0.1.70 it stopped short of the right edge on wide windows.
Картинка баннера снова на всю ширину. В 0.1.70 на широком окне она обрывалась, не доходя до правого края.
Scrolling past the banner on the home page no longer stutters on laptops and other modest graphics. The banner looks the same and is drawn in one pass instead of several.
Прокрутка мимо баннера на главной больше не дёргается на ноутбуках и слабой графике. Баннер выглядит так же, но рисуется за один проход вместо нескольких.
Settings answer at once while a download is writing to the disk. A change used to wait up to half a minute and then land with the clicks after it.
Настройки отвечают сразу, даже когда загрузка пишет на диск. Раньше изменение могло ждать до полуминуты, а потом применялось вместе со всеми следующими нажатиями.
The subtitle sample in Settings is drawn the way the player draws subtitles, over a picture of the last title watched.
Пример субтитров в настройках выглядит так же, как в плеере, и показан на кадре из последнего просмотренного.
The subtitle edge is Outline, Shadow or Box. Shadow is a visible drop shadow under a thin outline.
Контур субтитров: обводка, тень или плашка. Тень теперь заметная, под тонкой обводкой.
The player's episode list opens on the playing episode, with the one before it above, and no longer jumps.
Список серий в плеере открывается сразу на текущей серии, над ней видна предыдущая, и больше не дёргается.
In the player's download panel, the next episode shows its speed, peers and seeders.
В панели загрузки плеера у следующей серии видны скорость, пиры и сиды.
The scrollbar widens under the pointer, so it is easier to grab.
Полоса прокрутки расширяется под курсором, её легче ухватить.
Plain subtitles sit lower and are drawn at the size of styled anime tracks, with a firm outline and a tight dark shadow instead of a grey smear.
Обычные субтитры стоят ниже и рисуются размером со стилизованные дорожки аниме, с чёткой обводкой и узкой тёмной тенью вместо серого пятна.
When a new version is out, a card in the corner says what it brings, with a Download button. Settings, About turns the check off.
Когда выходит новая версия, плашка в углу рассказывает, что в ней нового, и даёт кнопку «Скачать». Проверку можно выключить в Настройках, О программе.
After skipping versions, what is new shows for all of them at once.
Если пропустить несколько версий, после обновления показывается, что нового во всех сразу.
Links and folders open in front of the window, not behind it.
Ссылки и папки открываются поверх окна, а не за ним.
A torrent is shared while it downloads or plays; the Always setting is gone.
Торрент раздаётся, пока качается или смотрится; настройки «Всегда» больше нет.
A torrent is shared while it downloads or plays. Settings, Downloads, Sharing can keep it shared always.
Торрент раздаётся, пока качается или смотрится. В Настройках, Загрузки, Раздача можно раздавать всегда.
A half-downloaded copy of an episode is dropped as soon as another copy of it plays, and stops taking bandwidth at once.
Недокачанная копия серии удаляется, как только играет другая копия той же серии, и сразу перестаёт занимать канал.
After an update, what is new shows once in the corner; Settings, About opens it again.
После обновления в углу один раз показывается, что нового; в Настройках, О программе это можно открыть снова.
Audio and subtitle languages are one section, Audio & subtitles, which the player's gear menu also opens.
Языки звука и субтитров собраны в одном разделе «Аудио и субтитры»; его открывает и шестерёнка плеера.
The player's keys in Settings are described in the interface language.
Клавиши плеера в Настройках описаны на языке интерфейса.
The volume slider marks 100%, where amplification starts.
На ползунке громкости отмечено 100%: дальше идёт усиление.
A poster with a caption opens from anywhere on it.
Постер с подписью открывается кликом по любому месту.
A film starts at once on a computer without hardware video decoding, instead of reopening three or four times and showing an error first.
Subtitles sit above the controls and stay there, instead of jumping up whenever the mouse moves.
Scoring a film or an episode you have not played here marks it watched and puts the title on My list.
Fill and zoom keep the player's on-screen messages whole.
A seek shows its time as text instead of a bar across the picture.
The next episode is offered on the last frame rather than thirty seconds early, and Skip ending appears when a chapter follows the credits.
The subtitle size you set is kept when a film opens.

The interface is translated, Russian first. It follows the system language, and Settings, General, Language switches it at once. Titles, descriptions and genres stay as the catalogue sends them, in English.
A download that stalled while the computer slept starts again by itself after waking, as after a network change.
A download that stalls after the network changes (a VPN switched on or off, another Wi-Fi) starts again by itself; pressing Play on a stalled download does the same.
The home screen no longer waits for an addon that never answered.
A title you start watching goes on My list.
New defaults: watched downloads are kept 30 days within 50 GB, and episode stills are shown.
The player opens without flashing the title and 100% over a downloaded episode; the next-episode ring runs from the moment its card appears; seeks show mpv's bar.
Windows: seek-bar previews and the second Esc work.
Settings scroll with the pointer anywhere in the window; the rating button is round; files opened from disk are no longer listed as downloads.

No source addon ships with the app: a fresh install starts with Cinemeta and OpenSubtitles, and until a source is added Play says "No source addons" and leads to Settings, Sources. An install that already has one keeps it.
The Sources page no longer has a Configure button; an addon is configured on its own site and its address pasted in.
Resetting settings is no longer undone by a change sent just before it.
Settings are one page with its sections listed beside it, and the list follows as you scroll.
Downloads can be paused and resumed, and a pause survives a restart.
The downloads panel groups downloads into ready to watch, arriving and waiting, shows how long one has left and why one waits, and names the copy (resolution, HDR).

New settings: seeding, upload and download speed limits, the download folder, how many days a watched download is kept, subtitle colour and styling, the arrow-key seek step, when the next episode is offered, and violet and teal accents.
Text size, timeline previews and the screenshots folder are kept per computer.
Settings can be reset to their defaults; About shows the player version, copies details and opens the logs.
Secondary text is set in Plex Sans; monospace is kept for paths, addresses and commands.
The Windows installer builds again.
Other accounts on the computer can no longer use Lumeo's core: every request carries a key only your account can read.
The searches you went through are offered again under the empty search field.
Playback settings choose how the next episode starts: after 5, 10 or 20 seconds, or only when you press it.
A download shows in the list the moment it starts, and says whether it is finding peers or fetching metadata.
A download that could not start, for example on a drive that was not mounted yet, is tried again the next time Lumeo opens.
A file opened with Lumeo starts playing at once and gets its title while it plays.
A damaged piece of a torrent no longer makes the player jump to a later scene or the end of the episode.
Freeing a download works while the app runs on Windows, and on Linux its disk space comes back at once.
Downloads on Windows take only the space they have fetched, so starting a film no longer stalls the disk.
Reopening the app right after closing it brings the window back, and the first screens wait for the core instead of showing an error.
Keep until watched frees a download as soon as its grace period ends.
The banners on the home screen and title pages grow to fit their text on a short window.
A Windows installer is on the release page, for Windows 10 and 11.
The app draws with Impeller, Flutter's current renderer, instead of the older Skia; the player's picture shows under it now.
The libraries in the package no longer point at the machine they were built on.
A Library tab: My list, with a shelf of new episodes of the series you follow, and History of what you watched, where episodes are rated.
A title page has + for My list and your 1-10 rating beside the source.
An empty source list says why: not out yet, a provider blocking, limiting or down, or no copies found, with Try again where it can help. Play is off when there is nothing to play.
The app starts its own core and runs once: a second launch raises the window, and after an update the window never talks to the old core.
A package for Arch Linux on the release page.

Pictures load better on a throttled network (without a VPN, say): a stalled image server is given up on in seconds instead of twenty, and a picture that failed is asked for again instead of staying blank.
A poster still loading shows its title card instead of an empty tile.
Safer: the core serves only video files, refuses requests sent by web pages, keeps addons from reaching your local network, and caps what an addon can make it hold in memory.
Downloads start on systems with IPv6 turned off.
After an update, series and film details are fetched again the first time you open them, so improvements such as stills for later seasons show up at once instead of a day later.

Episode details are refreshed daily again: a series you kept seeing in search or on the home page kept the episode list from the day it was first opened, without new episodes and without the stills for later seasons.
An episode on disk with no still of its own shows a frame from its file, taken once a third of the way in. Episodes with neither show their number on a plain tile.
The player's download panel shows this episode and the next: waiting, arriving, on disk, or no room with Download anyway. The button stays once the episode is on disk.
The downloads panel groups a season into one row that opens into its episodes, plays what is ready with a click, and keeps finished downloads for a day, a week or until Clear.
Once an episode is on disk, the next one starts downloading, so a series goes on without a wait. It stays within the disk limit and the free disk; a switch in Storage turns it off.
Storage has a disk limit and a keep policy: until watched, 30 days after watching, or forever. Over the limit, watched downloads go first; unwatched ones are never deleted.
Discarding one episode of a season pack no longer deletes the other episodes' files.
Under Play, one small button says whether it plays the copy on disk or streams, and opens the list of copies.
A download button beside the season tabs fetches every released episode of the season; on a film page it fetches the film. Its ring fills as the files arrive.
The list of copies has a one-line header.
Title pages that fit the window no longer scroll.
The subtitle language list in Settings no longer runs to the bottom of the window.
Episodes and films on disk open even when the source addon refuses to answer.
A watched episode or film started again and left half way resumes there, shows its bar and comes back to Continue watching.
The copies of a film or episode open in a drawer on the right, on disk first, then by resolution, with each copy's languages.
A poster has one bar, how much was watched; what is on disk is a mark in its corner.
Escape closes a dialog instead of leaving the page under it.
Hardware decoding uses mpv's auto-safe.
The seek bar shows the frame under the pointer, with the chapter and the time.
The time over the seek bar sits centred over the pointer.
The mouse wheel over the episode list in the player no longer changes the volume.
Series numbered as one long season upstream, Re:Zero among them, show episode stills after the first season.
Play on an episode that is not the selected one plays it.
The ring around the selected episode is drawn whole.
Settings sit on the left edge again.
The app says when the core it found running is from another release.
Settings show one section at a time: Appearance, Playback, Subtitles, Sources, Storage and About, without the paragraphs.
The accent is white, or amber, red or blue under Appearance.
Loading shows a spinner instead of the amber line.
"Open with Lumeo" on a video file plays it, under the title and episode named from the file and folder names; the next episode plays from the same folder.
The window comes back at the size it was closed at.
Keys work in the player while the film is still arriving.
The title page opens with the keyboard on the current episode, and the arrows run on into the next or previous season.
Watched episodes carry a full white bar instead of a check; the on-disk mark is a plain download arrow and the ring round the chosen card is thinner.
The player's episode list shows the same pictures as the title page.

The episode strip works from the keyboard: Tab enters it on the chosen episode, the arrows choose, Enter plays, and the chosen card is ringed in white with its neighbours in sight. A click chooses, the play button on the still plays.
Episodes on disk carry a download mark.
In the player, Esc leaves fullscreen first and the film only after; q leaves at once.
Subtitle style has a Background: none, shadow or box.
The next episode starts every time a film runs out, and its card comes back after seeking back from the end and watching it again.
The window reopens at the size it was closed at, maximised if it was.
Copies carrying your audio or subtitle languages rank above sharper ones without them.

description.p: Screenshots (s) are saved again with hardware decoding on: mpv now takes them on the GPU, as a JPEG instead of a 6 MB PNG.
A request caught on a connection that silently died, after a VPN switch or when Cloudflare goes quiet, is sent again on a new one, so sources and posters load instead of failing until a retry.
Artwork scrolled past before it finished loading is still cached, so every still of a long episode list is there offline.
Arrow keys seek exactly by their step. Posters and backdrops are cached on disk by the core and load once; Settings shows the cache and clears it.
A series watched up to its latest episode leaves Continue watching until the next one is out, and Play never points at an episode that has not aired, including in an announced season's tab.
The source list no longer hangs until a restart when a provider stops answering, and a provider that refuses is named instead of reading as "no copies".
Storage no longer counts episodes whose files were deleted outside the app.
Subtitle size no longer resets when the app starts before its core. Playback speed belongs to one film and is not carried to the next. A new icon, which the GNOME app grid now shows.
The player no longer crashes on Ctrl+V with mpv's console open (or whenever the window lost focus with a key held) on mpv 0.41.

Player fixes: the right-hand buttons stay at the right edge on a film with chapters, the volume slider is visible on hover, one click moves from one menu to another, a click on the picture closes a menu without pausing, and the next-episode ring fills smoothly.

The player is redesigned: a YouTube-style bar with white icons, a settings menu with pages (source, speed, picture, chapters, decoding, shortcuts), audio and subtitles side by side with a subtitle style page, an episodes panel, a next-episode card with a countdown, and a loading screen that names the episode.
Every key now goes through mpv: Escape, C and F11 are mpv bindings, mpv's console keeps its keys, shortcuts work on a Russian layout, quitting mpv closes the player, and zoom closes in on the cursor.

A film resumed after a pause with the window hidden no longer flashes an old frame among the new ones on NVIDIA: the player now draws in Flutter's own share group instead of handing frames over through an image that could go stale.

A film resumed after a pause with the window hidden no longer shows old frames among the new ones. The skip button takes the opening itself rather than a cold open marked before it, and a series caught up to broadcast stays in Continue watching.

The opening is skipped with a button, and an episode that runs out starts the next one by itself. Both are read from the chapters in the file, so a release that marks none is left alone rather than guessed at, and an episode that has not aired is never offered. Screenshots taken with S are saved to the pictures folder.

Minimise, maximise and close are in the player's top bar. The window's own title bar is drawn by Lumeo, and a film covers it, so a film used to be the one screen with no way to put the window away or shut it — only back out of the picture first.

A page that lists what every key and mouse button does, under the gear in the player. It is not written down here: mpv is asked what bindings it currently holds, and the page prints them with mpv's own description of each one, so a key mpv gains or loses appears or goes by itself.

The picture plays again. 0.1.19 stopped it on the first frame of every film — the sound ran, the seek bar answered a second late — because the new render thread timed frames by a clock mpv reports in different units than it documents. mpv now holds each frame to its display time itself, on that thread.

Scrubbing fast no longer freezes the picture and the seek bar together. mpv now renders on a thread of its own instead of the one that draws the controls, so a seek storm is mpv's to absorb and the bar keeps up with the pointer.

The mouse buttons on the picture are mpv's, as the keys already were: a click pauses, a second one within the double-click interval takes the pause back and goes fullscreen, and the right button pauses as it does in mpv.

A click on the picture pauses as it lands. It used to wait 300 ms to see whether a second click was coming; now the first pauses at once and a second within the interval takes the pause back and goes fullscreen, as on YouTube.
Dragging the seek bar keeps the controls up even when the pointer wanders off the bar. They used to fade under a thumb that was still being dragged.

The player's buttons answer on the click. The double click that goes fullscreen was listened for over the whole screen, and a double click is only known not to be one 300 ms after the first, so every button, the seek bar and the volume waited that out while the keys did not; two quick clicks on a button also went fullscreen. The double click now belongs to the picture alone.

Chapters, where the file has them: a mark on the seek bar where each one starts, the chapter's name over the pointer, and a list to jump by in the playback menu. PgUp and PgDn already stepped through them.

The player answers at once again. A blocking call in the video plugin held the interface for as long as mpv was busy, which was the length of every seek: clicks answered seconds late, the bar's thumb fell behind the pointer while it was dragged, and one press of an arrow became two or three seeks, because the release reached mpv after its auto-repeat had begun. The plugin no longer asks mpv anything from the interface's thread.
The loading ring means waiting for data and nothing else: it no longer appears on a pause or during a seek of a downloaded film.

The player's keys are mpv's. Every key goes to mpv with its own bindings and its own auto-repeat: seek by keyframes on the arrows, frame steps on . and , speed on [ ] { } and Backspace, volume on 9 0 and the wheel, chapters on PgUp and PgDn, loops on l, zoom and pan on Alt with + - and the arrows, subtitle delay on z and x, and I for mpv's own statistics page. Escape and q leave, c opens the audio-and-subtitles panel.

Seeking is instant on a downloaded file: a relative seek lands on a keyframe as it does in mpv, and the bar seeks as it is dragged so the picture follows the thumb. The controls come up when the mouse moves and go half a second after it stops; a key or a pause does not bring them up.

Audio and subtitles are one panel: the file's tracks and the database's copies as one list of languages, with the starting tracks chosen by mpv from the languages set in Settings. A file without a track in a preferred language starts with the best copy the database has. Subtitle size and height are settings.
The wait before the first frame stands on the title's artwork, and a click on the bar's gaps no longer pauses the film.

Watch progress. The player remembers where a film or episode was left and resumes from there; a series opens on the next episode with Resume and the time left, watched episodes are ticked, and the home screen starts with a Continue watching shelf. Progress is kept by the core, so another client of the same core resumes it.
Episode stills are blurred until the episode is watched, so a thumbnail is not a spoiler; Show, Blur or Hide is a setting.
The Storage section shows the disk — what Lumeo takes, what everything else does, what is free — and lists each title on disk with its size and a button that frees it, or all of it at once.

Add-ons are managed from the Sources section of the settings page: what each one provides, on or off, drag to reorder, install by address, Configure in the browser. They live in the core's database now; LUMEO_ADDONS only seeds one that has none yet.
The ground is plain black on every page. A film's artwork fills the window, and its list of sources scrolls into view when opened.

Settings that survive a restart. The subtitle languages you read, in order, and the playback speed are chosen on the settings page and kept by the core, so they hold on the next machine that talks to it; volume is remembered by the machine it was set on. The Storage section names the folder downloads land in and opens it when the core runs on this machine.
The settings page prints the commands that install a missing decoder, with a button to copy them.

The picture is handed from mpv to the window differently, which is what a film left paused for long enough used to come back without: the thread that draws no longer waits on mpv while mpv is waiting on it, and a frame is finished before the window reads it. The player also writes down what the picture is doing — its own numbers and mpv's own words — so a picture that stops leaves a record rather than somebody's memory of it.

The click that closes one of the player's menus no longer carries on to the film and pauses it. The menus hang off the button that opens them, close on Escape or a click outside, and can be walked with a keyboard.

Search opens on the line the tabs stand on, rather than against the top of the window, and the answers unroll under the field and fold away with it instead of appearing and vanishing whole. What the list puts first is what the typed word actually names: the exact title, then the titles that begin with it, then the ones that merely carry it — rather than one film and one series in turn.

Search answers while the name is being typed: each title with its artwork, films and series in one list, walked with the arrow keys. The middle of the window's bar is now where it is browsed from — Home and Settings, with search beside them — and a download starting no longer moves any of it: what is arriving is a ring at the right, and a row in the list it opens leads to the title it belongs to. There is also a Settings screen: which core this client talks to and whether it answers, and what this machine can actually decode.

Stopping one episode of a season pack now takes it off the swarm. Until this it kept downloading beside the episode being watched and took peers from it. And a film that will not start says exactly that: the message no longer claims a copy has no picture when nothing has been said about its picture.

A film that has only just started downloading is no longer reported as a copy with no picture: playback waits until the start of the file is actually on disk, both ends of the file are asked for ahead of the rest so it gets there sooner, and the player is given time to match a swarm rather than a web server. While a film is on its way its name is on screen, and a film that stops to wait for the swarm says so instead of looking frozen.

Lumeo now asks mpv what this machine can decode before a copy is chosen: a release nothing here can play is marked in the source table and Play passes over it, and a film whose sound will not decode says so instead of playing in silence. Ctrl+F and F11 answer on a window nobody has clicked, the controls no longer wash over the whole picture, a click on the timeline lands where the pointer said, episodes with no still of their own show the title's artwork, and a finished download plays again after the core has been restarted.

A series page opens on its seasons and episodes instead of below them, and the line that ran across the artwork is gone. The bar is the same on every page, Ctrl+F reaches search, a film takes the screen, and a copy that will not decode says which decoder is missing here.
The timeline can be hit: tap anywhere on it, or drag its handle. Leaving a film started from the banner no longer starts it again, and the artwork behind a title fades instead of being cut off.
A soundtrack nothing can decode no longer hides a film that plays. Seeking goes where it was asked, held arrows repeat, and Escape comes back to the title.
Films play again: the renderer was hiding the picture. Pages can be walked back out of, the download list can be reached, and Play starts something.
The window draws its own title bar, takes an icon and goes fullscreen. Sources need no configuring to play something.
First packaged build.
